title: Code and data for: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation in Brazil: a nationwide study of public and private health-sector hospitalizations, 2015–2025
description: Code, pseudonymized analytic data and aggregated results to reproduce the tables, figures and supplementary tables of a nationwide study of transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and surgical aortic valve replacement in Brazil's Unified Health System (SIH/SUS) and private health plans (ANS TISS), 2015–2025, with mortality (SIM), accreditation (CNES) and judicial-request (e-NatJus) data. All sources are public; hospital and hospitalization identifiers were replaced by meaningless codes.
